notes: All eight differentiators are shipped and 45 of 51 matrix rows are at parity or better. The two missing rows are reasoning control (V13, planned) and npm publication (owner action).

The loop runs on the owner's Windows machine (Node 26). Main passes the full local suite after every group of merges: typecheck, lint, 2,947 tests with coverage, fallow, docs snippets and the four Agent Forge checks. The last run found both Forge typechecks broken by the peer-range change; fixed in #164, and every ticket now runs them.
ai v7: peers accept ai 4, 6 and 7 (D28d #160). OpenAI and Anthropic projects are scaffolded on ai 7. Ollama and OpenRouter stay on ai 4 until D28f and zod 4 support (D29) land; both are in flight.

Breaking or model-visible changes shipped pre-1.0 (all in CHANGELOG with migration notes): sandboxed commands no longer inherit the host environment (X11); CLI commands reject unknown flags (U21); a tool's own deny now beats a permissions allow rule (X3); a cancelled tool call's result uses the shared error shape (U14.2); MCP tools without readOnlyHint ask for approval by default; error codes renamed to LOUSHY_*.

Limits left in shipped features, each with a ticket: Docker containers are not routed through the credential broker yet (X12.2, in flight); agent-directory builds fail when an unused optional peer is not installed (P8.3, in flight); any Slack workspace member can click Approve or Deny (P5.2); a remote sub-agent that pauses for approval is reported as an error (Y7.2). Without tickets: the registry's permission manifest is shown but not enforced; ACP has no file or terminal methods; Slack and Discord hold pending approvals in memory (one process each).
Open problem: on this machine the deploy test folder intermittently makes vitest exit at startup when run right after another deploy run. It passes on retry; the cause is not found.
Branches are never deleted (owner instruction). To save disk, installed dependencies are removed from an agent's worktree after its PR merges.
CI is not awaited (owner instruction). CI pins Node 22; the local runs use Node 26. npm publish is an owner action (D49 prepares it).
